name: [Lie of the Holy Night] Santa Blanche

sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Success value 100. 4x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs and special debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 120 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 2 when using an Ability.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies World Element (increases max HP by 100%, increases all stats by 100%, increases critical hit chance by 100%, and nullifies buff removal effects and debuffs) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
